dimensions.label: GEO
dimensions.criteria: GEO diagnostic criteria: required product/page identity, graph references, schema structure, validation stability, plus the on-page citation gatekeepers confirmed by controlled research (SIGIR 2026): an explicit price and a freshness timestamp. This is schema hygiene, not a citation-probability estimate. FAQ/HowTo presence earns no points.
evidence: No price information in the schema.
No published/modified date in the schema.
Optional entity inventory: FAQ 0, HowTo 0 steps, Breadcrumb 0; presence itself earns no points
Images 0, offers 0, additional properties 0 strengthen PDP identity
All local schema references resolve to target nodes
No content applicability plan is available, so semantic FAQ/HowTo suitability is not scored
Output is built without warnings or automatic repairs
improvements: Add a published or modified date (dateModified) to the page. A recent timestamp is a confirmed AI-citation gatekeeper.
State the price explicitly in the schema. Controlled research confirmed explicit price as a primary AI-citation gatekeeper.
Basic product information (name, description) that search engines can read is missing. Fill in the product info first.
The page is missing its one-line introduction. Add what this page is about.

dimensions.label: CEP
dimensions.criteria: CEP diagnostic criteria: source-present ingredient, benefit, and customer-choice context. CEP is a qualitative marketing framework (Ehrenberg-Bass) with a weaker evidence grade than the other dimensions; cue regexes are cross-checked against the content plan so one missed detection cannot swing the score. It does not predict citation rate.
evidence: 0 ingredient signals and 0 benefit/effect signals available
Customer selection criteria are not explicit enough
improvements: Help customers judge 'is this for me?' by mentioning skin type, concern, or usage situation (e.g. 'if your skin feels dry and tight').
Key ingredient information is thin. Pull more ingredient details from the product source.
It's not clear what improves after use. Strengthen the copy around the changes customers can expect.

dimensions.label: E-E-A-T
dimensions.criteria: E-E-A-T diagnostic criteria: this is a proxy for evidence and scoping hygiene, not Google's E-E-A-T rating — it checks evidence-link coverage, sample/time context on numeric claims, and claim-distortion signals. Validation warnings are penalized under GEO only.
